vision: Breakout where the bricks pulse to a beat, and hitting a brick on the beat does double damage.
A lunar lander with limited fuel, random wind gusts, and three landing pads worth different points.
A tiny tower defense on one winding path. Place three tower types with the number keys and survive 10 waves.
A one-screen platformer where you collect three keys to open the exit door, with wall jumps and spikes.
An endless runner through a neon city. Swap between two lanes and jump over drones; speed keeps rising.
Asteroids, but your bullets wrap around the screen and can hit you too.
A falling-block puzzle where three same-colored blocks in a row clear, and every clear speeds up the fall.
A top-down arena shooter: WASD to move, arrow keys to shoot in four directions, survive waves of chasing enemies.
Frogger with a chicken: cross roads of cars and rivers of logs, getting faster each level.
A Sokoban puzzle game with five handcrafted levels, a move counter, and an undo key.
A typing game where words fall like meteors; type a word to destroy it before it hits the city.
A flappy-style game where you fly a paper plane and wind gusts change direction every few seconds.
A tiny turn-based roguelike: three procedurally generated floors, bump-to-attack, health potions, and a boss on the last floor.
A 3D low-poly endless car racer on a neon highway. Dodge traffic while your speed keeps increasing.
A first-person 3D maze where you find the exit before your torch burns out; torches on the walls refill it.
A 3D space dogfight against five drone ships inside an asteroid field.
Tilt the board to roll a marble to the goal without falling off the edge, across three levels.
A cozy fishing game with a timing minigame and six fish types that each fight differently.
A four-lane rhythm game with a synthesized song and perfect / good / miss judgments.
A simple pinball table with two flippers, three bumpers, and a score multiplier lane.
Tron light cycles against three AI bikes; last one riding wins the round, best of five.
Minigolf with six holes. Aim with the arrow keys and hold Space to charge your shot.
A vertical bullet-hell shooter with one boss that has three distinct attack phases.
A tiny farming game: plant, water, harvest and sell crops over five in-game days to hit a money goal.
A top-down stealth game: sneak past patrolling guards with visible vision cones to reach the exit.
